description: This file defines data models for weather data, including current weather, forecast, location, conditions, and user settings, using Kotlin data classes with JSON serialization annotations.

classes.name: CurrentWeather
classes.description: Model for current weather data containing location and current conditions.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Details of a geographic location including name, region, country, coordinates, and local time.

classes.name: CurrentCondition
classes.description: Weather conditions including temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, visibility, and weather condition.

classes.name: WeatherCondition
classes.description: Describes specific weather phenomena with text, icon, and code.

classes.name: ForecastResponse
classes.description: Combined response including location, current conditions, and forecast data.

classes.name: Forecast
classes.description: Forecast containing a list of forecast days.

classes.name: ForecastDay
classes.description: Weather forecast for a specific day including date, day summary, and hourly data.

classes.name: DayForecast
classes.description: Aggregated weather data for a day such as max, min, and average temperatures and conditions.

classes.name: HourForecast
classes.description: Hourly weather forecast data including time, temperature, humidity, wind, and conditions.

classes.name: FavoriteLocation
classes.description: Represents a user's favorite location with optional current weather data.

classes.name: WeatherSettings
classes.description: User preferences for temperature and wind speed units.

classes.name: TemperatureUnit
classes.description: Enumeration for temperature units (Celsius or Fahrenheit).

classes.name: WindSpeedUnit
classes.description: Enumeration for wind speed units (KPH or MPH).
